qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominates global semiconductor process control with ~56-58% market share; decades of proprietary defect signature databases, optical/e-beam algorithms, and deeply integrated fab recipes create insurmountable switching barriers. Moat proof: 10-year GAAP ROIC consistently 30-58% (5-year median 54.7%), gross margins stably 61-63%, and EBIT margins ~40% across semiconductor cycles. Primary erosion risks are US-China export restrictions, customer concentration among top tier foundries/memory makers, and potential long-term R&D pushes in e-beam metrology by semicap peers.
qualitative.note: Dominant semiconductor process control toll booth (~56-58% market share) with unassailable defect libraries and high-margin recurring service contracts (>75% renewal). Insulated from AI disruption as leading-edge nodes (GAA, EUV, advanced packaging) drive rising inspection intensity. Fortress balance sheet with net debt under 0.9x net income and >20x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: process-control intensity & service volume 7.0% + pricing/mix 2.0% + packaging/reinvestment 1.0% - China mature node drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year track record of superior capital efficiency: GAAP ROIC sustained between 30% and 58% (median 54.7%) and Tangible ROIC 70-135%. FY2025 revenue reached $13.58B with EBIT of $5.89B and Net Income of $4.83B. High-margin recurring service revenues account for ~23-25% of total sales with >75% subscription renewal rates. Free cash flow conversion averages 86% over multi-year cycles with capex <3% of sales. Long-standing Outsider-style stewardship under CEO Rick Wallace with 17 consecutive years of dividend increases and aggressive counter-cyclical share repurchases ($5B in 2025, $7B in 2026). Fortress balance sheet: Net Debt of $4.24B is repayable in 0.88 years of net income, and EBIT interest coverage exceeds 20.7x.
